title: December — EN/ES/FR (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 96bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling intimate Australian summer Spanish French language learning family Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
December comes with heat in Western Australia's June-reversed way
The jacarandas all in purple and the children have their say
School is finishing, the garden's at its fullest before the dry
December is the month the whole year builds itself toward and by

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
Diciembre llega con calor — al revés del norte
[December arrives with heat — opposite to the north]
En Australia del Oeste el verano es el aporte
[In Western Australia summer is the contribution]
Las jacarandas en púrpura y los niños en la calle
[Jacarandas in purple and children in the street]
Diciembre es el mes que el año entero lleva y trae
[December is the month the whole year brings and takes]

[Chorus — English]
December, December
Longer days and shorter nights and everything I remember
The smell of sunscreen and the sound of the back door screen
December is the month that holds between what was and has been
The gardens still growing

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Décembre arrive avec la chaleur de l'été austral
[December arrives with the heat of the southern summer]
Les jacarandas violets dans le jardin natal
[Purple jacarandas in the family garden]
Les enfants finissent l'école et le jardin est plein
[The children finish school and the garden is full]
Décembre est le mois qui relie la fin et le prochain matin
[December is the month that connects the end and the next morning]

[Outro — All three languages]
December… Diciembre… Décembre
Summer in the south — Verano en el sur — Été dans le sud
The gardens still growing
